name: Gatekeeper Wuwei
title: Warden of the Seven Steles
description: A gaunt man in grey, one cheek webbed with an old burn scar. A long hooked staff leans at his elbow; a sleeping black scorpion rides on his collar as if it were a brooch.
dialogue: Few come this way by accident, cultivator. Say what you came to say.
Beyond these stones, the sect does not hate; nor does it love. It weighs.
Antidote is a courtesy. Venom is the honest speech. Remember which is which.

If you would walk the seven steles more than once, I can teach you the sting — the mortal-tier fingerwork we give our own children before they are trusted with a cup. Do not ask for more until you have asked for less.

1: The scorpion does not wake for you anymore. That is the whole of my welcome; do not ask for more.
-2: Pause. The seven steles remember your step. Walk softly.

name: Matriarch Shan
title: Hand of the Five Poisons
description: A woman of middling age, her hair coiled with silver pins shaped as centipede legs. Her robes are dust-grey; her eyes are the pale yellow of old amber. She does not seem dangerous until you realise she has not blinked.
dialogue: Sit. The serpent listens first, the scorpion second. I, last.
We are not the Scarlet Lotus. We do not love cruelty; we only refuse the lie that cruelty is the only evil.
Bring me three proofs — venom of valley, venom of road, venom of snow — and we will speak of the palm that empties the heart.

3: The valley opens for you as it opens for our own. Sit. Drink. The serpent has learned your step.
If you should ever need a hall to stand between you and the sword — the Five Poisons remembers you.
1: You are not a stranger now. The gatekeeper's scorpion did not rouse when you crossed the steles.
-2: Speak plainly, outsider. The valley does not lie, but it weighs every breath that enters it.

5: So. You are a sword of the Azure Cloud and still you come to my hall. That is either courage or confusion; I have not decided which.

venomhand_bai: Bai. You came the long way. Good. The scorpions tire of hearing about you second-hand.
Tell your wanderer that whatever road they take next, I count the Pavilion as the one road the valley will not follow. Tell them that too.
companion_reply.disciple_meilin: So — the Cloud and the Valley both in my hall, at one shoulder. A small marvel. Sit, sword-sister. The serpents have learned your step as well.
companion_reply.blood_sworn_jin: You bring the Pavilion's stray dog into my hall. He will not bite — I can see that — but the dog's master has teeth enough for both. Speak carefully.

name: Apothecary Qi
title: Keeper of the Five Basins
description: A small, round, ink-stained woman who always seems to be mid-sentence with someone who is not in the room. Her sleeves jingle faintly: vials, or teeth.
dialogue: Pearl? Pill? Pollen? I have them all and none of them are a bargain. Choose bravely.
A poison that cannot be cured is only an accident. We sell the cure and the cause both — it is only fair.
The Nine Serpents Pill is a guest in the dantian. Welcome it; do not bow to it.

name: Venom-Handler Bai
title: Sister of the Black Lattice
description: A lean woman in dust-grey, sleeves pinned back to the elbow. Her forearms are webbed with pale scars — each the trace of a venom that did not quite kill her. She is pruning monkshood with her bare hand and does not look up as you approach.
dialogue: Mind where you step. The ground remembers every bite.
Matriarch Shan says the best road for a venom-handler is an outside road. It was not advice; it was a warning.
I have tested a poison on every finger of this hand. None of them are lying.
If you find me too quiet on the road, it means a plant spoke louder. Don't take offense.

2: You took the Oath; you smelled the censer. That is more than most outer disciples ever do.
If you ever ride out with a blade at your back — I would not mind being the other blade.
-2: You've stepped on something the valley knows the name of. It has not forgotten.

3: You smell of red lotus. The pond-pavilion is not my road; do not mistake my silence for welcome.

companion.recruit_dialogue: Bai wipes her hand on a rag that is already green and looks at you sidelong. 'Matriarch let me out of the garden twice in five years. Third time's yours — don't waste it.'
companion.decline_dialogue: Bai keeps pruning. 'The Matriarch weighs each oath three times. Come back when the valley has counted you, not before.'

location_barks.azure_cloud_outer_gate: Bai pulls her sleeves down over the wrist-scars. 'Sword-folk read scars for sins. Walk ahead of me; let them read yours first.'
location_barks.azure_cloud_inner_courtyard: Bai stays near the pillars, eyes on the courtyard. 'Too many hands here, and every one of them clean. Do not make me speak unless you must.'
location_barks.scarlet_lotus_shrine: Bai sniffs once, sharp. 'Their venom is not ours. They use the pain; we use the weight. Still — I would not drink here.'
location_barks.crimson_creek: Bai dips a finger into the creek and touches it to her tongue, then spits. 'Cinnabar and old sorrow. The valley would never have let this water stand.'
location_barks.bandit_road: Bai walks slightly ahead on the open road. 'If you are bitten on this stretch, hold the wound open. Do not close it. I will come.'
